reviews.summary: The archive page /d/2026-11-02/ now has neutral dated PT and EN headings, and the 11-01 JSON no longer has -0.0 in energy_eur_kwh. The index keeps its tomorrow wording, but it currently shows 03.11 (today's prices) because OMIE has not published 04.11.

While tomorrow is unavailable, / shows a 'Luz hoje' h1 with today's date, an EN 'today' heading, PT/EN status lines with 13:00 and 13:45 UTC, and a title/og:title without amanhã. JSON and archive pages are unchanged. The 'Luz amanhã' available state could not be seen live.

Feedback links appear in both language sections on the home page and the day pages. Vote pages redirect back to the entry via meta refresh, and the report link goes to a prefilled issue on formachines-ai/luz-amanha. The footer disclosure is intact.
All three acceptance criteria were observed on the live site. The /brand/ page, the avatar SVG and the favicon link all match the task.

Both PNGs are served with 200 and image/png, and /brand/ links them next to the SVG with the footer intact and no JS. The SVG and favicon are unchanged, and the renderer reproduces the SVG's shapes and colours at 512 and 1024.
The home page, JSON and day page all show the promised honest-completeness texts, Lisbon-time line and wholesale note. No config/tariff.json remains and the JSON gained only the two new fields.
Both pages show vs percentages that match recomputation from Lisbon-hour averages, with PT and EN basis notes. JSON fields are preserved with only a basis field added.
The PT and EN caveat lines sit in the div.windows block, ahead of the chart, on both / and /d/2026-11-04/. Page structure, values and URLs look intact.

**Данные:** в метриках от 03.11 18:00 UTC виден только полный день 02.11 (до пилота); блок 03.11 обрезан, поэтому эффект постов 03.11 оценить не по чему.

| Уровень | 02.11 |
|---|---|
| Краулеры | 62 запроса, 9 источников (ClaudeBot 29, GPTBot 24) |
| Люди (источники) | 52, из них engaged 10 |
| Возвраты | 0 |
| Целевое действие: /go/telegram/ (люди) | 4 источника, 4 запроса |
| Агенты | 16 запросов, 3 источника (curl 14, okhttp 2) |
| Внешний referer | 0 (список пуст) |
| 5xx | 0 |

Это нулевая база, а не результат. Клики на Telegram 02.11 в основном шли до T-0001 (21:31 UTC), когда ссылка вела на заглушку.

**Посты 03.11:** Telegram и Bluesky в 14:09, X в 17:12, Mastodon в 18:14. Referer-данных и `by_src` нет, сравнить часы до и после постов нельзя.

**Цели:** G1 0 из 30 (пилот стартует 04.11), G2 не читать до 10.11, G3 подписчиков в метриках не видно, G4 0, G5 наблюдаем.
